title: Your Audit Risk Results
headings: Our Free In-person Audit Support has you covered.
text: Your Audit Risk Results Good news — your return looks risk-free! Our Free In-person Audit Support has you covered. There's no guarantee you won't be audited, but we guarantee you're covered. When you successfully file with H&R Block, you get Free In-person Audit Support. IRS correspondence management — We'll help with communication initiated by the IRS or your state tax office. Audit preparation — We'll provide details on how to prepare for an audit and what to expect. Audit representation — An H&R Block enrolled agent will attend the audit with you and manage the entire audit experience. All of this included when you file with H&R Block. Never Settle for Less.SM
